If I'm rejected from w too, I go to y. My priority at y is 1. This could be a good fallback, but the value ($60) is lower than x and w.

If I'm rejected from y, I end up at z ($63). My priority at z is 2, so that's not ideal, but it's a reasonable outcome.

Given the general preference for y and x, I believe my best strategy is to lead with x, hoping to get in despite my rank of 2. If I don't, w is the most promising option because of my rank of 1 there. Y is a good safety, and z is a last resort. I'm banking on my rank of 1 at w being enough to secure a spot if x doesn't work out, and anticipating a lot of competition for x.
